name: Control transfers retain target result and error rules

input.fixture_ref: Audit IRIS-V1-CONTROL-C049 and C068 control-transfer table rows and their future cross-links.

applicability.reason: Supported as a DOCUMENTATION audit. C069 requires every control transfer in this chapter to have a target, result and error rule stated in C049's loop table or C068's exception and callable-return table, which is a property of the specification TEXT rather than of any program, so no runtime observation could establish it. The row names the artifact, the clauses introducing each table and how many transfers each must carry, and the validator reports a table that is absent, short, or leaves any cell unstated. Measured: C049 carries 7 transfers and C068 carries 12, with no unstated cell.
